claims.explanation: Nitrofurazone is a prodrug that is reductively bioactivated by nitroreductases such as NQO1 to reactive hydroxylamine/ROS intermediates, causing DNA damage and oxidative stress. Sensitivity is predicted by high NQO1 expression and by a hypoxic/pseudohypoxic state (e.g., VHL mutation), while activation of the NRF2 antioxidant program (NFE2L2/KEAP1 mutations) and survival signaling through PIK3CA/KRAS may protect cells. ATM loss may further sensitize to DNA damage.
